citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The facility is not providing adequate veterinary care to the animals. A juvenile Degu has an approximate one inch by one
inch hair loss area on its right hip. A budgie is missing feathers along its abdomen The facility failed to contact the
attending veterinarian or seek veterinary care.
Failure to provide appropriate methods to prevent, control, diagnose, and treat diseases and injuries can lead to
worsening of medical conditions resulting in unnecessary pain and distress to the animals.
Correct by ensuring that the animals listed above and the condition of the animal are reported to the attending
veterinarian so that the animals can be properly examined, diagnosed, and treated.
Correct by September 12, 2026

At the time of the inspection, there wasn’t an inventory or animals on hand document for the animals at the facility.
Complete acquisition information is necessary for trace-backs and for identification purposes. The licensee must ensure
that the APHIS form 7019 or alternate document with all the required information is kept up-to-date and must obtain the
name and address of their animal sources at the time of acquisition.
Record of Animals on Hand (other than dogs and cats) (APHIS Form 7019) and Record of Acquisition, Disposition, or
Transport of Animals (other than dogs and cats) (APHIS Form 7020) are forms which may be used by dealers and
exhibitors to keep and maintain the information required by paragraph (b)(1) of this section concerning animals other than
dogs and cats except as provided in § 2.78.
Correct by September 12, 2026

citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
An individually housed white faced capuchin in an indoor enclosure, is unable to see and hear other nonhuman primates.
The current plan does not address special considerations for the individually housed nonhuman primate that is unable to
see and hear its own or compatible species. Failure to ensure that the environmental enhancement plan addresses
special considerations and to ensure that the plan is implemented accordingly can lead to psychological distress and
prolonged discomfort. Correct by ensuring that the environmental enhancement plan addresses special considerations
and is approved by the attending veterinarian.
Correct by September 12, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representative.
